label: Private credit growth
description: Annual growth rate of total private sector credit — money borrowed by households and businesses from financial institutions.
explainer: Credit growth is a leading indicator of economic activity and financial risk. Rapid credit growth (above 10% per year) often precedes asset price bubbles and financial instability. Australia saw credit growing at 15–20% per year during the mid-2000s housing boom. When credit growth collapses — as in 2019 — it signals a credit crunch that can drag on growth.
projection_source: RBA Statement on Monetary Policy credit aggregates projections.
